settings.gain_source: the brief: |S| = 32 subcomponents per matrix with a fixed seed, from those whose write is non-zero on the rows (den > 0 in the do-nothing)

rules.R0: Stage 0 stops the job (results/stopped.json names the rule) on any miss: (a) do-nothing: max over all variables of |dd| exactly 0.0 and E_b exactly 1.0; (b) gain x2: E_b >= 0.5; also each matrix has at least 32 subcomponents with den > 0 in the do-nothing, and every state's sha256 equals its pod's record. Edge cases checked before filing: the do-nothing's delta-W is 0 in every matrix, so kstar_vpd._site sets dU = dV = 0 and delta-W_out = 0, rf equals rm bit for bit, every dd is a sum of exact zeros, and E_b takes the convention 1 (sum of dd = 0, no division); the gain item's den > 0 on every chosen subcomponent by construction, and `explained` gives 0 (not a division) for any variable with den = 0 or num <= 0 (gain <= 0), so E_b lies in [0, 1] (explained <= dd by Cauchy-Schwarz); a gain item whose split put everything in remainders would read E_b near 0 and stop the job, which is the miss the control exists to catch. (c) and (d) are read, not stops: floor = |E_b(gain x2, bf16 autocast forward) - E_b(gain x2, fp32)|.
rules.R1: Stage 1, per arm (R, N, F) and seed: gap = E_b(update) - E_b(its random change). above random if gap > 0.02 at both seeds; below random if gap < -0.02 at both; as random if |gap| <= 0.02 at both; else mixed. Edge cases: E_b is always defined (1 when the sum of dd is 0, which no non-zero update gives), so a gap is always a number; a gap of exactly 0.02 is as random. The card stop: every one of the six gaps within 0.02 closes P3.14 with that reading. (below-random label added 2026-11-22 by qwen-lead before any run.)
rules.R2: Reported beside R1, not part of it: the stage-0 floor; if the floor exceeds 0.02 the labels are read against a gap the forward's precision alone can move, and the lead is told.

expected.gain_x2: E_b well above 0.5, near the 67M's 0.76 (over K*; over all variables here)
expected.gain_x2_bf16: within ~0.005 of the fp32 reading (floor under 0.005)
expected.random_probe: near the 67M's random 0.011; a Gaussian change has almost no part along each subcomponent's own write
expected.reuse_check: relative difference of explained and dd at check_site ~1e-5 or less (fp32 moments against fp64 positions)
expected.rival_a: each update's E_b above its random change by more than 0.02 at both seeds (card rival_a)
expected.rival_b: each update's E_b within 0.02 of its random change (card rival_b)
